nodes.label: Calligraphic Logo vs Geometric UI Tension
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.norm_label: calligraphic logo vs geometric ui tension
nodes.rationale: Deliberate tension between an ornamental calligraphic logo and a sober European geometric UI; the only bridges are the italic serif accent (echoes logo curves) and spaced small caps labels (echo HOMES). No other logo ornament carries to the UI.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: El Eden habitado
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: el eden habitado
nodes.rationale: Edennia sells arriving at a green, calm place and staying; translated into air, protagonist photography and a green that earns each appearance. The real house is the hero; the UI steps aside. Low density on public web, medium density in admin panel, same DNA.

nodes.label: The Expansion Rule
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: All UI text designed for +35% length (English to German); no button or chip has fixed width.

nodes.label: The Flat-By-Default Rule
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: Nothing has a shadow at rest except what floats; no shadow colored other than ink or forest-900. Depth comes from photography, hero layers and paper/white/sand contrast.

nodes.label: The Glass Once Rule
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: backdrop-filter glass only on the pill nav and the hero house label, never on cards.

nodes.label: Hero Logo Decision B (emblem only while wordmark visible)
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.norm_label: hero logo decision b (emblem only while wordmark visible)
nodes.rationale: While the giant wordmark is on screen the nav shows only the emblem; after the hero the compact header shows the flat lockup. Never two 'Edennia' in the viewport at once.

nodes.label: Light Theme Only (v1)
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: Users (European browsing on sofa/laptop, advisor in bright Villa Morra office) have good ambient light, so light theme; forest-900 dark sections are rhythm moments, not a mode.

nodes.label: Motion Principles (slow, soft, dispensable; power3.out)
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: Content visible without JS and without animation; GSAP only adds. No bounce or elastic. Admin panel limited to UI transitions <=300ms.

nodes.label: The One Italic Rule
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: Italic serif appears at most once per headline and never in paragraphs, buttons or the admin panel.

nodes.label: The One Leaf Rule
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: One protagonist color accent per screen; if the primary button is forest-900 nothing else competes in saturated green in that viewport.

nodes.label: The Photo Leads Rule
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.rationale: No color background, gradient or pattern where a real photo should go; missing photo shows neutral sand-100 placeholder with emblem, never a gradient.

nodes.label: Real Data Only (no invented testimonials, counters, urgency badges)
nodes.community_name: Sistema de diseño y primitivas UI
nodes.norm_label: real data only (no invented testimonials, counters, urgency badges)
nodes.rationale: Counters only for real DB figures; no fake 'trusted by' logos, testimonials, discount or urgency badges.
